title: A decline-only cursor write at the end of a pass could replace the cursor of a placement that committed but whose commit reply was lost
resolution: The end-of-pass write now uses a conditional PlacementRotation.advanceFrom that stores the move only while the stored cursor is still the one the pass read; adapters, a conformance case, a lost-commit regression test, contract, spec, and design follow.

title: The design said every offer of a pass moves the cursor, which is not the rule after the stop at the first fleet decline
resolution: The design now states that each placement sets the cursor and that only a pass without a placement moves it, to its last own-reason decline before the fleet decline or outage.

title: The rationale against deriving the cursor from assignments claimed every own-reason decline leaves no record, though a rejecting reason commits the end of the attempt
resolution: The rationale now covers only the declines that roll back or commit no assignment and names the rejecting-reason path through endRejectedAttempt.
